if(NOT DEFINED TARGET_ARCH)
  if(WIN32 AND CMAKE_CROSSCOMPILING)
    # Cross-compiling with MinGW: CMAKE_SYSTEM_PROCESSOR reflects the build host, not the target, so pull the architecture out of the target compiler's triple prefix instead (e.g. "x86_64-w64-mingw32.shared-gcc" -> "x86_64").
    get_filename_component(compiler_filename "${CMAKE_C_COMPILER}" NAME)
    string(REGEX MATCH "^([A-Za-z0-9_]+)-w64-mingw32" _ "${compiler_filename}")
    set(target_processor "${CMAKE_MATCH_1}")
  elseif(MSVC AND CMAKE_CXX_COMPILER_ARCHITECTURE_ID)
    # MSVC: the compiler's target (X86, x64, ARM64). CMAKE_SYSTEM_PROCESSOR is the host's in a native build, so a 32-bit
    # build on 64-bit Windows would report AMD64.
    set(target_processor "${CMAKE_CXX_COMPILER_ARCHITECTURE_ID}")
  else()
    set(target_processor "${CMAKE_SYSTEM_PROCESSOR}")
  endif()

  # Normalize to the spellings akousma.nsi.in and Info.plist.in expect: native Windows/macOS report things like "AMD64" or "ARM64".
  string(TOLOWER "${target_processor}" target_processor_lower)
  if(target_processor_lower MATCHES "^(x86_64|amd64|x64)$")
    set(TARGET_ARCH "x86_64")
  elseif(target_processor_lower MATCHES "^(aarch64|arm64)$")
    set(TARGET_ARCH "arm64")
  elseif(target_processor_lower MATCHES "^(i[3-6]86|x86)$")
    set(TARGET_ARCH "i686")
  else()
    set(TARGET_ARCH "${target_processor}")
  endif()
endif()

configure_file(${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/scripts/maketarball.sh.in ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/scripts/maketarball.sh @ONLY)
if(RPM_DISTRO AND RPM_DATE)
  configure_file(${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/unix/akousma.spec.in ${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/akousma.spec @ONLY)
endif()

if(APPLE)
  if(DEFINED ENV{MACOSX_DEPLOYMENT_TARGET})
    set(LSMinimumSystemVersion $ENV{MACOSX_DEPLOYMENT_TARGET})
  else()
    set(LSMinimumSystemVersion 12.0)
  endif()
  # Sparkle's keys, only with Sparkle (an update feed set with AKOUSMA_SPARKLE_FEED_URL).
  set(INFO_PLIST_SPARKLE "")
  if(HAVE_SPARKLE)
    string(CONFIGURE "${AKOUSMA_SPARKLE_FEED_URL}" sparkle_feed_url @ONLY)
    string(REPLACE "&" "&amp;" sparkle_feed_url "${sparkle_feed_url}")
    string(APPEND INFO_PLIST_SPARKLE "  <key>SUFeedURL</key>\n  <string>${sparkle_feed_url}</string>")
    if(AKOUSMA_SPARKLE_PUBLIC_ED_KEY)
      string(APPEND INFO_PLIST_SPARKLE "\n  <key>SUPublicEDKey</key>\n  <string>${AKOUSMA_SPARKLE_PUBLIC_ED_KEY}</string>")
    endif()
  endif()
  configure_file(${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/macos/Info.plist.in ${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/macos/Info.plist)
endif()

if(WIN32)
  # The installer lists files of optional features only when the build has them.
  if(HAVE_QTSPARKLE)
    set(NSIS_QTSPARKLE 1)
  else()
    set(NSIS_QTSPARKLE 0)
  endif()
  find_package(Qt${QT_VERSION_MAJOR}Svg QUIET CONFIG)
  if(Qt${QT_VERSION_MAJOR}Svg_FOUND)
    set(NSIS_QTSVG 1)
  else()
    set(NSIS_QTSVG 0)
  endif()
  if(HAVE_AUDIOCD)
    set(NSIS_AUDIOCD 1)
  else()
    set(NSIS_AUDIOCD 0)
  endif()
  message(STATUS "Installer: QtSparkle ${NSIS_QTSPARKLE}, Qt SVG ${NSIS_QTSVG}, Audio CD ${NSIS_AUDIOCD}")
  configure_file(${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/windows/windres.rc.in ${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/windres.rc)
  configure_file(${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/windows/akousma.nsi.in ${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/akousma.nsi @ONLY)
endif()

if(UNIX AND NOT APPLE)
  install(FILES ../data/icons/48x48/akousma.png DESTINATION share/icons/hicolor/48x48/apps/)
  install(FILES ../data/icons/64x64/akousma.png DESTINATION share/icons/hicolor/64x64/apps/)
  install(FILES ../data/icons/128x128/akousma.png DESTINATION share/icons/hicolor/128x128/apps/)
  install(FILES unix/io.github.genki_jp0.Akousma.desktop DESTINATION share/applications)
  install(FILES unix/io.github.genki_jp0.Akousma.metainfo.xml DESTINATION share/metainfo)
  install(FILES unix/akousma.1 DESTINATION share/man/man1)
endif()

if(APPLE)
  install(FILES "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/macos/Info.plist" DESTINATION "${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/akousma.app/Contents" COMPONENT macos_bundle_resources EXCLUDE_FROM_ALL)
  install(FILES "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/macos/akousma.icns" DESTINATION "${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/akousma.app/Contents/Resources" COMPONENT macos_bundle_resources EXCLUDE_FROM_ALL)
  install(FILES "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/macos/akousma.entitlements" DESTINATION "${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/akousma.app/Contents/Resources" COMPONENT macos_bundle_resources EXCLUDE_FROM_ALL)
endif()
